VERIFIED is only reachable through verify(), which requires work in COMPLETED_REPORTED with a stored outputRef whose artifact was recorded by the coordinator; a fabricated output/evidence ref cannot set state VERIFIED.
revokeForParent/stop revokes dispatch, cancels live children to CANCELLED, and confirms teardown; dispatch revalidates the admitted grants and drops revoked ones.
resume() creates a new child run epoch and rechecks parent, project, grant and account binding plus role availability; stale authority is refused while prior history stays readable.
Late outputs from cancelled/failed works are stored as historical artifacts (lateArtifacts) and never revive or complete the parent.
recover()/reconstruct() rebuild the graph purely from durable store facts; in-flight works become INTERRUPTED/UNKNOWN and out-of-order events cannot produce phantom completion.

requiredCases.evidence: Delivery only moves ACCEPTED->ENTERED_RUNTIME->HANDLED through explicit adapter-ack entry points (markEntered/markHandled); admission alone cannot mark a message delivered â€” no optimistic Delivered state exists.

admit dedupes on dedupeKey+content identity: an identical retry replays the stored record (one input ID through retries, no duplicated user message); a conflicting reuse writes a REJECTED record rather than throwing.

Steering admission requires the adapter-declared live-steer acknowledgement path (releaseLive/sendInput honors adapter ack); without it the input is queued after current â€” a queued message is never relabelled as live steering.

cancel() and reorder() only touch delivery=ACCEPTED items; reordering a set that misses any queued input or includes a non-queued id throws INVALID_AGENT_INPUT; cancelling an ENTERED_RUNTIME item is rejected.
Ambiguous native delivery marks UNKNOWN; reconcileUnknown() resolves strictly from the native receipt ('entered'->ENTERED_RUNTIME, 'notDelivered'->ACCEPTED) instead of blind replay.

Task-scoped board: sender/recipient must be registered owners (task thread or delegate child of it); replyTo must reference a posted message; text XOR artifactRef enforced; >4KiB text rejected; >100 active messages per task rejected; posting creates no grants and executes no commands.
recover() maps never-dispatched ACCEPTED inputs to REJECTED and unacknowledged ENTERED_RUNTIME inputs to UNKNOWN â€” no replay of unresolved deliveries.

PlanRecordSchema v1 and PLANNING_PROVENANCE are untouched; the sidecar lives in its own 'planExtension' store kind keyed by planId and binds the canonical plan record found in the 'data' kind â€” no hidden fields added to persisted v1 plans.

put() rejects when extension.canonicalRevision does not equal the canonical plan's current revision, and when extensionRevision is not the stored+1 â€” stale sidecars are rejected, never silently merged.
validate() rejects duplicate/self/dangling parent relationships, cycles (walked with an explicit seen set), weights that reference unknown nodes, and missing weights on children.

split() divides the parent's existing allocation: residual parent weight = weight - already-assigned units; requesting more than the residual throws. Positive-integer units (1..1e6) are schema-enforced.

progress() rolls up leaf weights as {completed,pending,unknown,total} rational shares; children whose subtree cannot be fully attributed are counted in the unknown share â€” no fabricated 0%/100%, and reported completion stays distinct from verification.

report() emits deltas of non-self events since reportWatermark, durably records an 'agentWorkReport' record, and only then advances the watermark (to the last delta seq, capped at 500 deltas); unchanged history is never repeated and report creation cannot change task completion.
